text:
When building the error review's input for a failed or rejected job, include each producer and verifier invocation's policy_denials (tool and detail, clipped) next to its report. Add a test: when a producer invocation has a denial, the denial text appears in the input the error review receives. Evidence: the review of job 20261031-043143-vbee said the producer gave no explanation and blamed job size, but the producer's report said the hook blocked its output file. crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs never reads policy_denials.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: The error review never sees an invocation's policy denials, so it blames job size or scope when a denied command stopped the work
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs
